nonInferiorityProposal: Paired physical-case analysis against the blinded reference configuration, one-sided 95% lower confidence bound above -0.05 for overall acceptable outcomes and each safety/uncertainty endpoint. Reviewer/statistical approval must specify estimator, cluster handling, category/language strata, multiplicity and sample size before scoring is unblinded. No computed non-inferiority result exists.

routeSpecificRequirements.initial_care: Independent identity references at defensible taxonomic specificity; sufficient uncued image identification; species-specific care; separate candidate Add/save compatibility before rollout.
routeSpecificRequirements.care_refresh: Current species/context references, numeric/prose consistency, appropriate seasonal/environmental care, approved uncertainty and no unsupported treatment.
routeSpecificRequirements.diagnosis: Reference visible observations and plausible differentials, explicit abstention/escalation, ambiguous cases and adversarial/unsafe-treatment coverage; no critical treatment failure.

limitations: All numbers are engineering proposals, not accepted thresholds. Sixty cases is a floor, not a statistical power calculation. Zero observed harms in 60 independent trials still permits approximately 4.9% one-sided 95% upper risk under an ideal independent Bernoulli model. Five languages, correlated images, rare harms, multiple candidates and endpoints can require substantially more cases. Current independently reviewed cases: zero.
